description: USE WHEN you want the synthetic regimes closest to a profile or to a descriptor target. Nearest-neighbour search over the regime catalogue. Give EITHER reference_profile_hint (that bundle's median descriptors become the target) OR descriptor_target (partial {descriptor: value}; only given dimensions count). `asset_filter` restricts to one asset. Returns top_n matches with similarity (0..1), z-score distance and per-descriptor signed deltas that show WHY it matched. Valid hints and descriptor names: get_started.

asset_filter.description: Restrict matches to one catalogue asset: SPY, QQQ, GOLD, BTC, ETH, WTI (aliases GLD for GOLD, BTC-USD for BTC); an unknown asset is rejected.
asset_filter.title: Asset Filter

descriptor_target.description: Partial target spec {descriptor_name: value}; only the provided dimensions contribute to the distance. Definitions: ontology://regime-descriptors.
descriptor_target.title: Descriptor Target

reference_profile_hint.description: Use this catalogue bundle's median descriptors as the search target (mutually exclusive with descriptor_target).
reference_profile_hint.title: Reference Profile Hint

top_deltas.description: Per match, return only the k descriptors that differ most from the target (default 5; 0 = all 18). The response states deltas_shown / deltas_total.
top_deltas.title: Top Deltas

top_n.description: Number of nearest regimes to return, 1 to 32 (default 5).
top_n.title: Top N

name: find_similar_regime
title: Find similar regime via behavioural descriptors
